In team play, competitive lobbies and Premier mode, players with many commends are taken more seriously. Streamers, tournament players and community leaders actively use CS2 commend boost to maintain profile reputation.
seo2.types_title: Friendly, Teaching, Leader — What Do They Mean?
seo2.types_list:
• Friendly commend: Sportsmanlike behavior, kindness, respect for teammates.
  • Teaching commend: Helping new players, in-team coaching, mechanics training.
  • Leader commend: Team leadership, strategy calls, in-game leader (IGL) role.
seo2.types_body: The commend count you order is split evenly across all three categories. For example, a 300-pack → 100 friendly + 100 teaching + 100 leader commends. This balance keeps your Steam profile looking natural.
